disposition.reason: Docket 114-7-99 Vtec appeals the ZBA's denial of a stay of enforcement of a notice of violation for operating a commercial mobile home display and sales business without a permit. It is a municipal appeal, but it concerns a nonresidential commercial use and enforcement of a notice of violation, not permission for new housing.

evidence.quote: In Docket No. 114-7-99 Vtec, Defendant-Appellants appealed from a decision of the ZBA denying their request for a stay of enforcement.
These four consolidated cases all involve a mobile home display and sales facility
citing him for carrying on a commercial business without a permit, directing him to cease operation and take corrective action within seven days

judgments.note: The shared decision covers four dockets; 114-7-99 is only the appeal of the ZBA's denial of a stay of enforcement of the commercial-use notice of violation (decided in 113-7-99). The subject is a mobile home sales business (commercial use), and the docket is a notice-of-violation enforcement matter, both non-housing under the guide. The single permitted double-wide residence is not at issue in this docket. The court held the docket moot and entered final judgment.
Appeal from a ZBA decision (denial of a stay of enforcement).
Commercial mobile home display and sales use; notice-of-violation enforcement; no new housing permission sought.

history.note: Excluded: appeal of ZBA denial of a stay of enforcement of an NOV against a commercial mobile home sales business.
